Select molecule_chembl_id AS compound_chembl_id, canonical_smiles, compound_records.compound_key AS compound_key, docs.pubmed_id AS pubmed_id_or_doi, assays.description AS assay_description, activities.standard_type, activities.standard_relation, activities.standard_value, activities.standard_units, activities.activity_comment, target_dictionary.chembl_id AS target_chembl_id, target_dictionary.pref_name AS target_name, target_dictionary.organism AS target_organism From activities Join assays On activities.assay_id = assays.assay_id Join target_dictionary On assays.tid = target_dictionary.tid Join compound_structures On activities.molregno = compound_structures.molregno Join compound_records On activities.record_id = compound_records.record_id Join docs On compound_records.doc_id = docs.doc_id Where activities.standard_type = 'IC50' And activities.standard_relation = '=' And activities.standard_units = 'nM' And target_dictionary.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL2815' And activities.standard_value IS NOT NULL And activities.standard_value > 0 And activities.standard_value < 1000 Order By molecule_chembl_id, canonical_smiles, compound_key, pubmed_id_or_doi, assay_description, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units, activity_comment, target_chembl_id, target_name, target_organism
